description.narrative: HOPE-S is a five-year UK-funded programme designed to address the widespread gender-based violence (GBV) and conflict-related sexual violence (CRSV) in Sudan’s conflict-affected areas. Building on two decades of UK partnerships with civil society, the programme will deliver a holistic response that combines survivor-centred services, social norm transformation, and locally led risk mitigation. It aims to strengthen women-led organisations and grassroots actors through flexible funding and technical support, improve access to essential health and psychosocial services, and reduce stigma and harmful practices that perpetuate violence. By empowering communities, supporting reintegration of survivors, and tackling root causes of GBV, HOPE-S contributes to Sudan’s long-term resilience and aligns with UK priorities on Women, Peace and Security and the Preventing Sexual Violence in Conflict Initiative.
